proposedEntry.name: ux-writing
proposedEntry.description: Writes interface microcopy (buttons, error messages, empty states, destructive confirmations, placeholders, tooltips, toasts, field labels) to a per-element-type rule table, or strips AI-generated tells out of existing copy in a separate mode. Strip mode checks copy against a 13-row banned-pattern table (inflated significance, promotional adjectives, negative parallelism, em dash, Title Case in labels, apology with no fact, unnamed consequence, and more) with a bad/fixed example per row, and reports exactly which named rows applied. Both modes run every draft through an 8-question pre-ship self-check gate before it ships (any single 'yes' forces a rewrite, not a footnote). Preserves every number, name, and stated fact verbatim; defers to a supplied brand voice guide wherever it conflicts with the defaults; flags legal/compliance copy for human sign-off instead of silently rewriting it.
triggers: write the button copy for this flow
strip the AI tells from this text
inputs: a UI component or flow description with no existing copy (write mode)
an existing string of interface copy to check and rewrite (strip mode)
outputs: write mode: one labeled line of shippable copy per element, in the order a user meets them
strip mode: a Before/After block per string with the named banned-pattern rows removed
